facts.fact: NPC chairman Aminu Ibrahim Yusuf said digital birth and death registration on the VitalReg E-CRVS platform began on 1 July 2026 and is operational in all 36 states and the FCT, with paper forms no longer used.
NPC said deaths are registered in the same digital E-CRVS/VitalReg system, in operation since 1 July 2026.
NPC chairman said national birth registration coverage is about 57 percent and death registration below 20 percent, rates not tied to the digital system.

facts.fact: NPC said birth and death registration moved to the digital VitalReg system from 1 July 2026 in all 36 states and the FCT, no longer on paper forms.
NPC chairman said it has established 4,011 functional registration centres across the 774 Local Government Areas and aims to reach about 8,000.
